name: TSMC’s N7 immersion FinFET process
description: TSMC introduced its original 7 nm FinFET foundry process with immersion lithography, before selectively inserting EUV in the N7+ variant.

date.basis: Date or date granularity stated in the cited source.

events.statement: TSMC began volume manufacture on base N7.
events.caveats: N7 and N7+ are separate process variants within one foundry family.

evidence.locator: Printed p. 11, N7, N7+ and N6
evidence.supports: The annual report dates N7 volume production to April 2018.

evidence.locator: Printed pp. 3–4, C. C. Wei prepared remarks on N7 and N7+
evidence.supports: The contemporaneous call confirms volume production and identifies immersion layers replaced on the later variant.

earliest_record.rationale: The dated TSMC call and annual report establish the month of base N7 volume production.

links.statement: Did base N7 use the same 193 nm immersion technique documented on earlier TSMC production processes?
links.scope: Use of the immersion technique within TSMC’s process generations.

evidence.locator: Printed pp. 3–4, C. C. Wei prepared remarks on N7 and N7+
evidence.supports: TSMC identifies immersion layers and equipment carried over or changed from N7.
The lithography lead identifies 193 nm immersion as the process family extended through the pre-EUV generations.

links.caveats: TSMC describes immersion use and intended EUV substitution. A separately inspectable primary comparison is needed to close the link for the exact production technique.
